svg.aria-label: SOLID principles in Java with before and after examples
svg.text: Five object-oriented design principles, popularized by Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob),
that make code easier to understand, extend, test and maintain.
A class should have only one reason
Each class does one job and does it
Easier to test, read and reuse.
